correctness.rationale: Independently, tr(X[X,Y])=tr(Y[X,Y])=0 forces X,Y upper triangular at [X,Y]=e. Their two coefficient rows (a,b),(d,f) have determinant 1/2, giving q(q²−1) ordered pairs. Both central input coordinates are free. Each block's vector equations have rank two, and translating (α,β) by (a,d)h changes ω by −s_i h, making c uniform when any s_i≠0. When all s_i=0, the lower coordinates are (α',β')=(a,d)t_i and aβ−dα=r_i+t_i/2; the block contributes −r_i t_i−t_i²/2 with q lifts per t_i. Completing the square gives sum_i(t_i+r_i)²=sum_i r_i²−2c. This proves the pointwise formula independently of the conjugating translation. The quadratic Gauss sum G²=χ(−1)q and additive orthogonality give the even correction χ((−1)^k)q^(k−1) times q−1 at zero and −1 otherwise, and the odd correction χ((−1)^k b)q^k. For fixed r, c runs through all b; each character class and the s≠0 branch have exactly the reported multiplicity. The lower level is zero only at n=1, and all three levels are distinct. Conjugation by g sends the vector blocks by g and z by det(g); one nonzero nilpotent Jordan block is GL₂-conjugate to e.
